fn MaxProfit(prices: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in prices: (x >= 0)
  ensures ((((result == 0) and (len(prices) == 0)) or (exists i in 0..len(prices): exists j in (i + 1)..len(prices): ((prices[j] >= prices[i]) and ((prices[j] - prices[i]) == result)))) or (forall i in 0..len(prices): forall j in (i + 1)..len(prices): (prices[j] < prices[i])))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (MaxProfit([]) == 0)
